source.title: Subvarieties of moduli spaces of curves: open problems from an algebro-geometric point of view

trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as the single zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/475348 with document identifier 475348. The zbMATH API identified the exact work as Ian Morrison, 'Subvarieties of moduli spaces of curves: Open problems from an algebro- geometric point of view', Contemp. Math. 150, pages 317-343, 1993. Crossref and OpenAlex confirmed DOI https://doi.org/10.1090/conm/150/01297 and the AMS resource URL https://www.ams.org/conm/150/1297/.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted, with blocked_or_challenged access on the zbMATH web page. Local curl to the zbMATH landing URL returned a Cloudflare challenge, but the zbMATH API was readable as resolver metadata. The AMS DOI resource redirects from https://www.ams.org/conm/150/1297/ to https://www.ams.org/books/conm/150/1297/conm150-1297.pdf and then to a LibLynx access-management page rather than a readable PDF. OpenAlex reports the exact work as closed access with no OA URL, no best OA location, no repository full text, and no fulltext content.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by exact title, exact title plus PDF, DOI, AMS PDF filename, author/title/page range, and zbMATH identifier. Candidate pages were rejected because they were the paywalled AMS/bookstore listing, ResearchGate or text mirrors for the different Fontanari article 'Moduli of curves via algebraic geometry', EMIS/CiteSeer copies of that different article, references or bibliography entries that only cite Morrison's paper, or unrelated moduli-space works. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML technical source containing the problem statements was recovered.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML technical source was recovered. The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH review metadata, Crossref metadata, OpenAlex metadata, AMS table-of-contents metadata, search snippets, citation-only bibliography entries, or different works.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim problem-statement quotes with page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable primary source artifact.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/475348.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
